CodeClash: The November Nexus 2026

A National-Level Coding Competition by Let's Code

Get ready for another exciting edition of CodeClash! After witnessing participation from over 20,000 students across previous editions, Let's Code Community is bringing back The November Nexus — a competitive platform to test your technical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and coding abilities.

Event Details:

  • Event Dates: 29–30 November 2026
  • Participation: Individual
  • Eligibility: Open to students and professionals from all academic backgrounds
  • Total Cash Prizes: ₹12,000
  • Rewards: Cash prizes, certificates, and recognition

Competition Structure

Round 1: Foundations Round (MCQ)

  • Date: 29 November 2026
  • Topics Covered:
    • Data Structures and Algorithms
    • Operating Systems
    • Database Management Systems
    • Computer Networks
    • Programming Concepts
    • Aptitude and Logical Reasoning

Test your fundamentals across key computer science subjects.

Round 2: Coding Challenge

  • Date: 30 November 2026

Put your problem-solving skills to the test with challenging coding problems designed to assess your logic, efficiency, and programming skills.

Participants will compete individually to demonstrate their coding abilities and secure a place among the top performers.

Rewards and Prizes

  • Winner: ₹5,000 + Certificate
  • First Runner-Up: ₹3,000 + Certificate
  • Second Runner-Up: ₹2,000 + Certificate
  • Third Runner-Up: ₹1,000 + Certificate
  • Fourth and Fifth Runner-Up: ₹500 + Certificate
  • All Eligible Participants: Participation Certificate and Certificate of Excellence (Rank wise)

Note: Incorrect or incomplete registration details may lead to disqualification and forfeiture of prize money. Final prize distribution and certificate eligibility will be announced in the official event guidelines.

Why Participate?

  • Compete with talented students and aspiring developers nationwide.
  • Strengthen your placement preparation.
  • Challenge yourself with technical MCQs and coding problems.
  • Showcase your problem-solving skills.
  • Earn recognition and add a meaningful achievement to your resume.
  • Become part of a growing community of developers and learners.

About Let's Code Community

Let's Code Community is building a tech-driven ecosystem where aspiring developers and professionals can learn, compete, collaborate, and grow.

Our Initiatives Include:

  • Interview preparation resources
  • Internship and job alerts
  • Coding contests and technical challenges
  • Peer discussions and mentorship
  • Career development opportunities

Stay tuned for registration details, the official schedule, and competition guidelines.

Get ready to think, code, compete, and conquer!

CodeClash: The November Nexus 2026 — Your Next Coding Challenge Awaits.
